analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.21) vs SMA5/20/50 ($0.18/$0.19/$0.18) — Confirms short-to-mid-term trend outperformance.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($0.19/$0.22) — Below mid-to-long-term trend, potential for reversal.
· 52-week position (8.2%) + Current price range historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.3→68.5) — Exited oversold, entering neutral zone with upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0020→0.0001) — Turned positive from negative, signaling strengthening uptrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.21) — Approaching upper band, caution for overheating.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) — Aligns with Pivot S2, strong support zone.
· Swing resistance ($0.21) — Aligns with current price, expect further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — Confirms recovery, uptrend continuation.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가 갱신하며 상승 채널 상단으로 이동 중. 20일 고가와 현재가가 동일하여 저항 구간 진입.

keyPoints: RSI 과매도 탈출 후 68.5까지 상승, 상승 모멘텀 강화.
MACD 히스토그램 음수에서 양수 전환, 골든크로스 임박.
5일 평균 대비 3.45배 거래량 동반한 10.23% 급등으로 스윙 저항선 $0.21 도달.
